independence: Wingless-only; Yggdrasil cannot validate, alter, or route this policy.
global_constraints: infra failure distinct from scientific negative
one high-information architectural discriminator; no parameter sweep

supported.hypothesis: The R44 pairwise intervention-choice effect replicates without refitting or richer allocation machinery on fresh disjoint manifests.
supported.design: Freeze three additional untouched manifests before R44 execution; reuse the exact R44 state, action set, pair set, scoring rule, thresholds, and budgets. No richer allocator.
supported.decision: Replication required before any richer allocator is authorized.
supported.next_if_supported: R46 prospective chooser under unchanged ranking rule
supported.next_if_negative: R46 treat R44 support as non-replicated and return to representation diagnosis

mixed.hypothesis: R44's partial ranking signal is carried by a bounded preregistered subset of existing R43 state components.
mixed.design: One fixed ablation only: remove the transition-activity group (entry, exit, active-motif components) from the existing six-component state while leaving pair set, unseen manifests, budgets, readout capacity, and thresholds fixed. No alternate ablations after results.
mixed.supported_interpretation: Ablated ranking accuracy falls and regret rises by preregistered margins, identifying necessary existing-state information.
mixed.negative_interpretation: Partial R44 signal is not localized to the preregistered component group; do not sweep other subsets.
mixed.next: Escalate according to the fixed result without a feature-subset sweep.

negative.hypothesis: The current R43 representation loses decision-relevant causal trajectory information; a deterministic richer causal/latent state representation with unchanged readout capacity can expose pairwise action value.
negative.design: Replace, rather than augment, the six R43 state components with a fixed six-dimensional causal-trajectory representation computed from within-budget state transitions. Keep candidate actions, unseen manifests, total data/compute budget, and linear readout parameter count unchanged.
negative.prohibited: No further scalar calibration, offset, threshold, pair-selection, or current-representation ranking tweaks.
negative.next_if_negative: Stop representation-local ranking work and move to upstream learning-state formation.
